remaining_work, over eff lanes, with borrow := enable. Per byte i: z := TestEq(pre_e[i], 0) then boolean; next := CondSelect{bit: borrow, a: z, b: 0} then boolean; c := Mul(256, next), bits 9; l := Add(pre_e[i], c), bits 9; r := Add(post_e[i], borrow), bits 9; ConstrainEq(l, r); borrow := next. After byte 15: ConstrainEq(borrow, 0).
constraints_owner_verbatim.basis: P4 remainingWork -= 1. The final borrow of 0 forces pre >= 1 (P2 excluded).

constraints_owner_verbatim.emit: consumed_work, helper_work and helper_visits, over eff lanes, with carry := enable. Per byte i: f := TestEq(pre_e[i], 255) then boolean; next := CondSelect{bit: carry, a: f, b: 0} then boolean; c := Mul(256, next), bits 9; l := Add(post_e[i], c), bits 9; r := Add(pre_e[i], carry), bits 9; ConstrainEq(l, r); carry := next. After byte 15: ConstrainEq(carry, 0).

caller_obligations_owner_verbatim.text: AB: step only with the image's own Admitted (SI-01, D-32). Host-only; the encoded form is open.
enable = 0 unless pre.outcome = Running and pre.helperWork < bounds.maxHelperWork, which routes P0 and P3 to their own branches.
enable is derived from the constrained pre-state selector, never from a free witness or expected data. Exactly one enable across the whole step relation.

pre_helper and post_helper are exact aliases of the bound pre and post reg.helper lanes. The typed lanes are the named fields; rest is the complete remaining partition (nothing omitted or duplicated) in identical order pre and post. Discriminator lanes hold the schema Enum ordinals and the space lane holds the ValueRef bit; a layout using other codes invalidates this leaf until re-review.

The value tables are all physical rows of the bound ProgramView prog.constants and the pre img.data, projected exactly to the variant tag ordinal lane and the U128.n byte lanes, with the true active lengths. Every projected cell is < 2^128 in every image where the fragment appears, whatever the value of enable.

Every pre/post cell outside this leaf is equal under enable: reg.control, controlOrigin, envRoot, depth, stackLimit, outcome, initialFuel, referenceCursor (D-09R), alloc.*, active.*, taskLive, result, segBase, and every image table and slot. Delta entries 4-10 are zero.
The counter and regA carriers are connected to the eventual serialized encodings by explicit constraints, because counterWidths and WidthTable are not frozen. Until then the carriers are local only.
StepInv on the pre-image is external (SI-03, SI-04, SI-08 result absent, SI-13, SI-17, SI-21 including operandA = top.left and site coherence, and SI-22 S1). Post-StepInv preservation is not claimed.

Program, pre and post statement binding and field embedding are external (L04 open). This is a mid-helper image, so it is never a canonical boundary (D-30); proof splits link physical images directly.
Every operand is bound before the fragment. The composer reserves the %{scope}. namespace non-nested against all other blocks.

Any bound event envelope or StepEvent records ruleId b.helper.Scalar.tag, HelperVisit, Applied, work/helperWork/helperVisits deltas 1/1/1, cursor delta 0, zero alloc and value-slot writes, and helperPhase First to Second. None of this is emitted here.
When enable = 0 the post lanes are determined by whichever branch is enabled, not by this leaf.
